preconditions.description: The integer d must be between 1 and 500 inclusive.
The integer s must be between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(n) if n > 0 else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal positive integer n divisible by d with a digit sum of s, or -1 if no such number exists.
